criteria.requirement: Fix deepcopy(Section/ConfigObj) to copy raw stored values rather than interpolated items. Preserve same concrete types, raw expressions, nested list expressions, comments/default metadata and internal parent/main graph links using the deepcopy memo. Cached interpolation engines must bind to the cloned sections. Copies must independently recalculate after root/nested changes; creating a copy must not trigger interpolation loops. Preserve the explicit evaluated semantics of Section.dict(), ordinary retrieval and existing pickle behavior.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
